body:
i went digging through The Decode last night and i can't stop thinking about the shape of it.

it's 42 hidden clues, each one lined up next to the exact moment it paid off. the oldest trail runs all the way back to august 2014 — the newest lands in 2025. eleven years of breadcrumbs, mapped in one place.

and the era that planted the most of them? Lover. twelve of the forty-two started there — of course they did, that was peak Easter-egg Taylor. (remember the seven palm trees she posted before TS7 even had a name? that one's in here.)

the whole trick is you can stand at a single clue and watch the thread stretch across the months to its answer. so her.

go read the rows yourself → longlivets.com/?lens=hidden-clues&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

Opener differs from the X half; shares the one handed photo + campaign + 23:00Z. Uncredited reddit pick -> no credit line. LFS pointer here, not eyeballed, relying on prepare-job vetting.

critique.rationale: The behind-the-data angle done as a fan reaction to the dataset's shape: 42 clues, 11 years, Lover densest, with the real seven-palm-trees clue as proof. Warm and checkable; the tour photo is real but only loosely tied to the clue subject.
